title: Yitzchak of Rabbi Yannai's school
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: So it is in Yoma 86a: he said, “What constitutes desecration of the Name? Anyone whose colleagues are embarrassed by his reputation.” But the name should read Yitzchak, son of Rabbi Ami, as in Dikdukei Soferim.[^1][^2]

notes.text: Hyman proposes replacing the school designation with “son of Rabbi Ami,” following Dikdukei Soferim; that is a textual proposal rather than a new identity binding.

Yoma 86a explicitly has Yitzchak of Rabbi Yannai’s school and the statement about colleagues embarrassed by his reputation. Hyman says the name should read Yitzchak, son of Rabbi Ami, following Dikdukei Soferim. That apparatus reading has not been directly collated here, and the proposed change is not adopted as a new identity binding.
